operation.target: Only the unique structural section id A8 previously matched as Appendix H; expected start LF2129 and closing-tag LF2228. The parser checks original source hash, exact tag boundaries, unique id, those two structural lines and example-element absence.
operation.permitted_output: Source SHA, unique section id, LF boundaries, 0-based character and byte offsets with exclusive ends, section-byte count, SHA-256, zero example-node count and structural validation status. The section bytes may be sliced in memory solely to compute the hash; no source prose, heading, formula, proof, example, bibliography or other source content is printed or saved.
operation.stop_conditions: Hash mismatch, parser exception, zero/multiple A8 matches, line mismatch, invalid tags or any example element => STOP; do not broaden search, retry or reveal body.

limits: Metadata-only document parsing; no scientific computation, source-body display or disk extraction. A matching range is not a theorem, source proof, or permission to use the body. No disjoint reviewer passed preliminary screens; all STOP/HOLD/ZERO, source pause outside this exact gate, L1, B/CLI holds, N4 UNKNOWN and auxiliary214 STOP persist.
